item.description:

Boy racers driving up and down cycle lane at night in cars and motorcycles, which lane is for cyclists and pedestrians only. Nearly knocked down last week by motorbike going 30mph on the path.

item.title: Road markings nearly disappeared, 13th July
item.description:
Road markings on Arle Road and especially the 'Keep Clear' section in front of 3A Arle road are faded. We have a lot of issues with cars waiting on the keep clear sign blocking us in when we're trying to leave the property. We feel this is partly due to the fact that the markings are so faded and people don't see it's a keep clear sign.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 7, Arle Road, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
